decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The proposed first floor side extension, by way of its position, size, scale, design and appropriate setbacks would be both proportionate and secondary in appearance to the original dwelling and would not be detrimental with respect the street scene or the immediate locality, nor would it be harmful to neighbours living conditions.  It therefore complies with policies ENV-B.1.1 (New Development) and H.6.4 (Extensions and Alterations) of The London Borough of Hounslow UDP, Adopted December 2003, and is compliant with Council's Residential Extension Guidelines.
Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of five years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing single storey side extension.

Condition : 4 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority.
Condition : 5 - No flank windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in the eastern sidewall of the extension hereby approved without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.
description: Erection of a first floor side extension to dwellinghouse.
